tools.name: analyze_address
tools.title: Analyze an address on Solana, an EVM chain, Bitcoin, Tron, dYdX or Noble
tools.description: Analyze a wallet with Iris: on Solana (also a token mint or a program), Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain, BNB Chain, Polygon, HyperEVM, Bitcoin, Tron, dYdX or Noble. The chain is read from the address (0x is Ethereum unless chain says another EVM chain). Costs 1 credit (2 when depth is over 1000), or without an API key $0.05 ($0.10 deep) paid per call with x402; refunded (never settled) if it fails. A token, or a wallet Iris hasn't read recently, can take about a minute. For a wallet: what it is (exchange, MEV bot, drainer, sniper, scam or poisoning wallet, personal wallet...), its risk score, its labels, its behaviours with example transactions, who first funded it and when, its first and latest transaction, where its money came from and went (largest counterparties, labeled), tokens it locked, look-alike (address poisoning) addresses, and the exchanges and mixers it moved money with, with the latest transaction for each (to use with trace_transfer). A Solana Privacy Rings or Solflare Private Mode user's steps there are shown too. For a token mint: its creator and the creator's funder, the launch bundle and who funded it, red flags, the wallets in its groups and its top holders. For a program: who can upgrade it, who deployed it, its top callers. Only the latest transactions (depth) are read. Returns a summary and a link to the full view on iriscan.app.

address.description: The address: Solana or Tron base58, 0x (EVM), Bitcoin (bc1, 1 or 3), dydx1 or noble1. On Solana also a token mint or a program.

chain.description: The chain, when the address's form doesn't say it: an EVM chain for a 0x address (ethereum by default). Read from the address otherwise.

depth.description: How many of the most recent transactions to read. Over 1000 is a deep analysis (2 credits, or $0.10 with x402). Smaller is faster: 200 is often enough for a first look.

tools.name: explain_transaction
tools.title: Explain one transaction
tools.description: One transaction read and explained in plain words: who moved what to whom, through which programs, the swap or bridge transfer it made, its parties with their labels, and (Solana) the wallets it shows are controlled by the same owner. A Solana signature, an EVM hash, or a dYdX, Noble, Bitcoin or Tron hash. Free with an Iris account (limited per minute, and per day without a paid plan).

chain.description: Optional: the chain. Read from the hash otherwise (an EVM hash is looked for on every EVM chain).

hash.description: The transaction: a Solana signature (base58), an EVM hash (0x...), or a dYdX, Noble, Bitcoin or Tron hash.

tools.name: find_token_insiders
tools.title: Find a token's insiders
tools.description: Find the wallets a token's creator is linked to by money (a Solana token, or a Robinhood Chain or BNB Chain one with chain), with the payments that link them and how much of the supply they bought and hold, and why none were found when none were. Costs 2 credits, or without an API key $0.10 paid per call with x402; refunded (never settled) if it fails. Can take up to two minutes. Results are leads, not proof.

chain.description: robinhood for a Robinhood Chain token (Pons launches), bsc for a BNB Chain one (Flap and four.meme launches).

limit.description: How many wallets to check. Fewer is faster.

mint.description: The token's address: a Solana mint (base58), or a 0x token with chain.

tools.name: follow_funds
tools.title: Follow the funds out of a wallet, hop by hop
tools.description: Follow the main stream of money out of one wallet, hop by hop, until it reaches an exchange (with the deposit address), a bridge, a mixer or a swap (it names the asset bought, to follow next), or comes to rest. On Solana, an EVM chain, Bitcoin or Tron. Each hop says how the money went, with its transaction. Money put into common DeFi positions is read back, and the walk goes on from the wallet paid; tokens put into a lock end it as locked. At a bridge it says where the money landed on the other chain when that is known: follow on from that wallet, on its chain. One wallet per call. Costs 2 credits, or without an API key $0.10 paid per call with x402; refunded (never settled) if it fails. Can take up to two minutes.

address.description: The wallet to follow from: Solana or Tron base58, 0x (EVM) or Bitcoin.

asset.description: Optional: "native" (SOL, ETH...), or a token's mint or contract. Whatever left the wallet otherwise (dollars first).

branches.description: Branches followed at each wallet: 1 keeps to the main stream; 2 to 5 also follow the largest branches, listed as side trails.

chain.description: The chain, when the address's form doesn't say it: an EVM chain for a 0x address (ethereum by default).

since.description: Optional: only outflows from this time on (Unix seconds), e.g. a hack's time.

until.description: Optional: the end of the incident's window (Unix seconds): nothing that moved after it is followed, on any hop.

tools.name: get_connections
tools.title: Get an address's connections
tools.description: Every counterparty of an address that analyze_address analyzed in the last hour on this account (without an API key: for the x402 payer whose receipt is given): wallets it sent to or received from and the venues it swapped on, with labels, the native coin (SOL, ETH, BTC, TRX...) and stablecoins moved each way, the number of transactions, and the date and signature of its first and last transfer (for trace_transfer). Covers the transactions that analysis read only. For a token: the wallets in its groups (creator, bundlers, insiders, wallets handed supply) and its top holders. Free, from the earlier analysis; run analyze_address first.

chain.description: Optional: the chain it was analyzed on, for a 0x address analyzed on several EVM chains. The latest analysis otherwise.

filter.description: flagged: threats, sanctioned and mixer counterparties, and look-alike (address poisoning) ones; for a token, its creator, bundlers and insiders. exchange or mixer: only those.

limit.description: How many to list, largest by value first.

receipt.description: Only without an API key: the receipt analyze_address gave when it was paid with x402.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.title: Get credits left
tools.description: The account's plan and what is left: analyses, traces and pack credits, when the allowance renews, and what each tool costs. Without an API key: what each tool costs per call with x402. Free.

tools.name: scan_launch_tool
tools.title: Scan a wallet for a launch kit
tools.description: Whether a Solana wallet launched or traded memecoins with a known launch kit, with the verdict, the transactions that show it, the tokens the wallet launched and the wallets that funded it, walked up to its root funder with what Iris knows of that root. A token's mint scans its creator. Costs 5 credits, up to a number of scans a day set by the plan, or without an API key $0.25 paid per call with x402; refunded (never settled) if it fails. Can take up to two minutes.

mint.description: Optional: narrow the report to this token (base58 mint).

wallet.description: The Solana wallet (a dev or trader), or a token's mint to scan its creator (base58).

tools.name: trace_transfer
tools.title: Trace a transfer through a mixer, exchange or swap service
tools.description: Follow one transfer through a mixer, a privacy pool, an exchange or an instant-swap service to its likely other side, on Solana, Tron, the EVM chains and Bitcoin: for a deposit, where it most likely came out; for a withdrawal, where it most likely went in. Give the wallet and the signature (transaction hash) of a transaction where it sent money to, or received money from, a mixer, an exchange or a swap service (analyze_address and get_connections list them). Returns ranked candidate wallets, each with a confidence and the transactions behind it, and one verdict line; a link is exact when it can be confirmed, and a ranked lead otherwise. Most deposits into an exchange are just deposits, and the verdict says so. With hops 2, a deposit is traced as a private swap through two exchanges, such as a Houdini Swap route. The chain is read from the wallet's address (pass chain for an EVM chain other than Ethereum). Costs 1 trace (or 3 pack credits), or without an API key $0.25 paid per call with x402; refunded (never settled) if it fails. Results are leads, not proof.

chain.description: The transfer's chain, when the wallet's address doesn't say it: an EVM chain for a 0x wallet (ethereum by default).

counterparty.description: Optional: the exchange, swap service or mixer wallet (or pool contract) on the other side, when the transaction moved money with several. Iris picks the one it knows otherwise.

direction.description: Optional, with counterparty: out when the wallet paid it (a deposit), in when it paid the wallet (a withdrawal).

hops.description: Optional: 2 traces the transfer as a private swap through two exchanges, such as a Houdini Swap route. A lead, not proof. 1 (the default): one exchange.

signature.description: The transaction: a Solana signature (base58), an EVM or Tron transaction hash, or a Bitcoin txid.

wallet.description: The wallet whose deposit or withdrawal is traced (not the exchange or the mixer).
